name: a3_right_place_red
goal: Right arm picks the standing IQBAR and drops it into the RED bin, left arm locked.
setup: IQBAR standing on its long narrow side, long axis front-to-back, right of centre, about 15 cm in front of the red bin and a hand's width from the right gripper; bins on their marks; arms at rest.
instruction: put the IQBAR box into the red bin
